item.description: Andrei Belousov to the servicemen who liberated Dobropolye: This victory will become a symbol of the courage and resilience of Russian troops and will go down in the history of the military exploits of these brigades and regiment Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov congratulated the command and personnel of the 110th Separate Guards Motorised Rifle Suvorov Order Brigade, the 114th Separate Guards Motor Rifle Brigade, the 61st Separate Guards Kirkenes Red Banner Marine Brigade and the 177th Separate Guards Marine Regiment on the liberation of the settlement of Dobropolye in the Donetsk People's Republic. ‘During the special military operation, these formations have been operating on some of the most challenging fronts. In fierce fighting, the servicemen of these units have demonstrated outstanding courage and bravery, decisively defeating the enemy on Donetsk soil,' the Russian Defence Minister noted. Andrei Belousov thanked the servicemen for their loyalty to their military duty and oath. He also expressed confidence that the personnel of these units would continue to carry out all assigned tasks with honour, reliably defend Russia national interests and ensure the country security. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Andrei Belousov to the servicemen who liberated Dobropolye: This victory will become a symbol of the courage and resilience of Russian troops and will go down in the history of the military exploits of these brigades and regiment
Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov congratulated the command and personnel of the 110th Separate Guards Motorised Rifle Suvorov Order Brigade, the 114th Separate Guards Motor Rifle Brigade, the 61st Separate Guards Kirkenes Red Banner Marine Brigade and the 177th Separate Guards Marine Regiment on the liberation of the settlement of Dobropolye in the Donetsk People's Republic.
‘During the special military operation, these formations have been operating on some of the most challenging fronts. In fierce fighting, the servicemen of these units have demonstrated outstanding courage and bravery, decisively defeating the enemy on Donetsk soil,' the Russian Defence Minister noted.
Andrei Belousov
thanked the servicemen for their loyalty to their military duty and oath.
He also expressed confidence that the personnel of these units would continue to carry out all assigned tasks with honour, reliably defend Russia national interests and ensure the country security.

item.title: 🔹 Valery Gerasimov: the Russian Armed Forces are carrying out systematic strikes Report
item.description: Valery Gerasimov: the Russian Armed Forces are carrying out systematic strikes Report by Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation – First Deputy Minister of Defenсe of the Russian Federation In response to attempts by the Kiev regime to disrupt Russian shipping in the Black Sea, the Russian Armed Forces are carrying out systematic strikes against Ukrainian port and logistics infrastructure and vessels. This has led to the suspension of operations at the main ports in the Black Sea. In accordance with the plan of the General Staff, strikes are also being carried out against strategically important bridges, railway transport facilities, and data centres involved in meeting the operational requirements of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. As a result of the strikes, 76 logistics and storage centres, 203 port infrastructure facilities, and 93 vessels transporting military cargo to Ukraine have been hit. Moreover, the Russian Armed Forces have begun carrying out massive strikes against Ukrainian energy facilities. A list of these facilities has been drawn up, along with the required allocation of assets to engage them. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation: Ukraine's industrial capacity has been significantly reduced
Report
by Valery Gerasimov:
On 7 October, a massive strike was carried out against Ukrainian defence industry enterprises involved in the production and storage of Flamingo cruise missiles and long- and medium-range Fire Point unmanned aerial vehicles.
As a result of direct strikes, the machining, testing, and assembly workshops as well as specialised equipment, finished products and components for the production of cruise missiles and unmanned aerial vehicles, were destroyed at the Yuzhmash Machine-Building Plant in Dnepropetrovsk.
Following secondary detonations, two production buildings and the Flamingo cruise missiles stored inside them were completely destroyed, along with components for FP-5 operational-tactical missiles at the premises of the Smart Ammunition LLC in Kiev. In addition, four production workshops manufacturing components for missiles and unmanned aerial vehicles, together with specialised equipment and finished products, were destroyed at the premises of the Kiev Cardboard and Paper Mill in Obukhov and the Mechanical Plant in Lozovaya, Kharkov Region. The operations of these enterprises have been suspended for an extended period.
In total, 12 massive strikes were carried out in September and October, targeting 30 defence industry enterprises and logistics centres involved in the production and storage of missiles and strike drones as well as 14 fuel, energy and transport infrastructure facilities. As a result, Ukraine's industrial capacity to manufacture long-range weapons, including cruise and ballistic missiles, has been significantly reduced. Its ability to procure the equipment required to restore the country's industrial and energy sectors has also been diminished.
At the same time, key enterprises in the metallurgical sector are being targeted in order to undermine Ukraine's military and economic potential. Their products are used in military manufacturing and are also exported to pay for deliveries of weapons and ammunition.
As of today, it can be stated that steel production in Ukraine has halted. The strikes have hit nine Ukrainian metallurgical enterprises.

Valery Gerasimov: Air defence lines and the protection of critical facilities are being strengthened
Report
by Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation – First Deputy Minister of Defenсe of the Russian Federation
Against the backdrop of a lack of results on the battlefield, the Kiev regime has opted to launch massive strikes against civilian infrastructure facilities in the Russian heartland. In January 2026, Russian air defence systems intercepted an average of around 120 enemy unmanned aerial vehicles and missiles over Russian regions per day. By September, this figure had increased more than fivefold. In September alone, more than 15,000 aerial targets were shot down, amounting to over 500 per day.
The largest number of aerial threats assets was deployed by the enemy between 19 and 20 September in an attempt to disrupt the elections to the State Duma. Within 24 hours, 1,398 strike unmanned aerial vehicles and eight cruise missiles were shot down over Russian regions. Despite the increasing scale and frequency of attacks against Russian civilian infrastructure facilities, Russian air defence destroys more than 98 per cent of enemy drones every day.
Nevertheless, some enemy drones still manage to reach their targets. Efforts to improve air defence capabilities are being carried out continuously. Air defence lines and the protection of critical facilities are being strengthened, while new and effective means of detecting and destroying unmanned aerial vehicles and cruise missiles are being introduced without delay.
In response to strikes by the Kiev regime against facilities on Russian territory, and in accordance with the General Staff's plan, massive and group strikes have continued against key defence industry facilities and logistics centres as well as energy and transport infrastructure facilities throughout Ukraine that support their operation. The highest-priority targets are facilities involved in the production of missile weapons and unmanned aerial vehicles, as well as their storage and launch sites.

item.title: 🔹 Valery Gerasimov: The Dnepr and Vostok groups of forces are maintaining the initiative
item.description: Valery Gerasimov: The Dnepr and Vostok groups of forces are maintaining the initiative Report by Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation – First Deputy Minister of Defenсe of the Russian Federation The Dnepr and Vostok groups of forces are maintaining the initiative advancing along adjacent flanks across a broad front in Zaporozhye direction. Formations of the Dnepr Group of Forces are engaged in combat operations to liberate Orekhov. The settlements of Novopavlovka and Novoandreyevka have come under Russian control. In addition, having crossed the Konka River, units of the Airborne Troops seized Malokaterinovka and are continuing their advance northwards. Forward units are positioned five kilometres away from the southern outskirts of Zaporozhye. Enemy positions within the city are being targeted. The Vostok Group of Forces, advancing in the eastern part of the Zaporozhye direction, has liberated more than 180 square kilometres and 10 settlements since the beginning of September. These include Samoylovka, Golubkovо and Nikolskoye, which came under Russian control in October. Alongside its offensive operations in the Zaporozhye direction, the Vostok Group of Forces is carrying out the task to set a security zone in Dnepropetrovsk region. Yesterday, the large settlement of Velikomikhaylovka came under Russian control. The enemy had turned it into a fortified defensive area in this direction. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation: The Zapad Group of Forces is continuing its offensive
Report
by Valery Gerasimov:
The Zapad Group of Forces is continuing its offensive in the northern part of the Donetsk People's Republic and in the east of Kharkov Region having completed the liberation of the Lugansk People's Republic in March 2026.
In Krasny Liman direction, the enemy, attempting to halt Russian advance, made unprecedented efforts to conduct counter-offensive operations, redeploying for this purpose its best-trained and motivated formations, staffed by nationalists and foreign mercenaries. However, it failed to achieve its objectives.
Against the backdrop of a lack of visible successes on the battlefield and severe losses, the enemy command once again resorted to staging false, media-driven victories, organising a series of publicity stunts as part of a planned information campaign. Nevertheless, on this direction alone, during summer and autumn, the Armed Forces of Ukraine lost more than 3,500 manpower from their most highly trained and combat-capable formations, killed or seriously wounded.
Formations of the 20th and 25th Combined Arms Armies have repelled attacks of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and have resumed offensive.  They are simultaneously conducting search operations to detect and neutralise scattered enemy groups that had attempted to infiltrate the rear of Russian forces.
In Kupyansk direction, units of the 6th Army, having thwarted enemy attempts to drive us out of Kupyansk, are advancing westwards, towards Shevchenkovo. The settlements of Palamaryovka and Kovalyovka have been liberated. The liberation of Zaporozhye region is proceeding according to plan.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
